natural_input.description: System overview: inside Instrument, Optical Front End contains Photodiode and Optical ADC; Thermal Front End contains Thermistor. Shared DSP and Shared Recorder belong directly to Instrument. External PC is outside Instrument. Only Photodiode -> Optical ADC -> Shared DSP, Thermistor -> Shared DSP, Shared DSP -> Shared Recorder, Shared Recorder -> External PC. Do not assume the front ends contain equal hardware.
